EVAL-F5-S11.title: Explainability Normalization Across Signals
EVAL-F5-S11.description: Implement normalization logic to ensure all explainability objects follow consistent phrasing, field structure, and ordering regardless of source (provider credentials, external links, clinical trials).

EVAL-F5-S12.title: Explainability Fallback and Missing Data Handling
EVAL-F5-S12.description: Add logic to generate safe, user-understandable explanations when upstream data is incomplete, unavailable, or ambiguous, including explicit limitation messaging.

EVAL-F5-S13.title: Frontend Interaction Patterns for Explainability
EVAL-F5-S13.description: Enhance chat UI to support expandable or clearly segmented explainability content so users can distinguish core signals from explanations without cluttering the conversation.
